candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. Access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret', so signature verification always fails and every protected request returns 401. The refresh strategy uses the refresh secret correctly, so login and refresh still work.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in JwtStrategy instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
